items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Salem Tutt Whitney who played Noah in the show of Noah's Ark said this about Denver...

ctx.x: From Chicago we went to Cleveland at the R.K.O. Theater for one week and from there to Denver, Colorado which was the farthest west I had ever been. We played the R.K.O. vaudeville theater and visited the Rocky Mountains.

Salem Tutt Whitney who played Noah in the show of Noah's Ark said this about Denver: 'Denver is a beautiful City. A mile above sea level. The altitude would make me lightheaded if I had not been like that all my life. It is hot as blazes here. One has to look at the snowcaps on the distant mountains to convince oneself that there is any cool weather anywhere. I am certain that the coloured people here have more beautiful homes than anywhere we have been'.
And that was true, and to protect those homes they had their own fire department which was something I never saw anywhere else in the U.S.A.
